items.lede: As flagship smartphones balloon in size, the Enough Phone offers a 5.3-inch handset. Choose between stock Android or an anti-distraction operating system.
items.title: Small Phones Have Vanished. Enough Phone Wants to Bring Them Back

items.lede: It won't win the specs race, but it will actually fit in your hand.
items.title: People say they want small smartphones—the Enough Phone will put that to the test
